description: Evidenca o subvencijah za nakup malih komunalnih čistilnih naprav, hišnih črpališč in nepretočnih greznic v Občini Kamnik is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA KAMNIK. Zbrika vsebuje podatke o izplačanih subvencijah za del stroškov nakupa malih komunalnih čistilnih naprav v Občini Kamnik v okviru javnega razpisa. Coverage: OBČINA KAMNIK. The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA KAMNIK. Its keywords include male komunalne čistilne naprave, nepretočne greznice, subvencije, hišna črpališča, prejemniki. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
